(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A method of treating a brain, comprising: inserting an elongated device into the brain to create a path; radially expanding the device to create a working channel along the path; and introducing a medical element selected from the group consisting of an instrument and a medicament into the working channel to perform a medical procedure on the brain.

(Currently Amended) Claim 4: The method of claim 1, further comprising creating an opening in a cranium, and inserting the elongated device through the opening.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The method of claim 1, further comprising inserting the elongated device at a location between tissue layers within the brain. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 7: A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the device against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially reinforcing the device against the tissue; and introducing a medical element selected from the group consisting of an instrument and a medicament through the device to perform a medical procedure on the tissue.

(Currently Amended) Claim 10: The method of claim 7, further comprising inserting the elongated device at a location between tissue layers.
